scope: Zinc blende CdSe core QDs only; excludes all subsequent CdS/ZnSe shell growth variants

source.title: Mechanistic Insights in Seeded Growth Synthesis of Colloidal Core/Shell Quantum Dots
source.authors: Igor Nakonechnyi, Michael Sluydts, Yolanda Justo, Jacek Jasieniak, Zeger Hens
source.section: Experimental Section > Zinc Blende CdSe Core QDs

materials.name: Myristic acid
materials.role: Precursor ligand; original surface ligand source

amount.unit: volume equivalent relative to reaction mixture

materials.name: Oleic acid
materials.role: Replaces myristate surface ligands with oleate

steps.title: Prepare cadmium mixture
steps.text: Mix 0.5 mmol CdO, 1.6 mmol myristic acid and 10 mL ODE.
steps.evidence: 0.5 mmol of CdO was mixed with 1.6 mmol of myristic acid and 10 mL of octadecene (ODE)

steps.title: Heat until dissolved
steps.text: Heat under ambient conditions until total dissolution at 260 degrees C.
steps.evidence: heated under ambient conditions until total dissolution at 260 °C

steps.title: Add selenium dispersion
steps.text: Swiftly add 0.24 mmol black Se dispersed in 1-octadecene. The dispersion volume and numerical injection duration are not reported.
steps.evidence: 0.24 mmol of black Se, dispersed as a powder in 1-octadecene, was swiftly added to the solution

steps.title: Grow for five minutes
steps.temperature_note: 260 degrees C is the reported pre-addition synthesis temperature; a measured post-injection temperature trajectory is not reported.
steps.text: Allow reaction for 5 min after adding Se.
steps.evidence: after 5 min, the reaction was stopped

steps.title: Quench and isolate
steps.quench: Thermal quenching using a water bath; bath temperature and cooling rate not reported
steps.text: Quench with a water bath. Add 2-propanol at 1:1 volume relative to the reaction mixture and centrifuge at 3000 g to obtain the pellet.
steps.evidence: addition of propanol-2 (1:1 in volume as compared to the reaction mixture) and centrifugation ... at a g-force of 3000 g ... to obtain a QD pellet

steps.title: Exchange surface ligands
steps.text: Redisperse the QDs in 1 mL toluene plus 1 mL oleic acid to replace myristate ligands with oleate.
steps.evidence: redispersed in a mixture of 1 mL of toluene and 1 mL of oleic acid (OA) to replace the original myristate ligands by oleate

steps.title: Purify three times
steps.text: For use in seeded growth, purify three times using 1 mL toluene and 1 mL methanol as solvent/nonsolvent. Centrifugation force is 3000 g according to the paragraph-wide condition; cycle duration and final storage solvent/volume are not stated.
steps.evidence: further purified thrice using 1 mL of toluene and 1 mL of methanol as the solvent/nonsolvent combination

diameter.method: Inferred by authors from first-exciton absorption using cited sizing relation

product.model_instruction: If displaying a roughly spherical atomistic particle, label it an illustrative zinc-blende CdSe model at nominal ~3 nm, not measured morphology or a reconstructed experimental particle. Do not use a wurtzite lattice.
product.measurement_stage_note: The 537 nm absorption peak and approximately 3 nm diameter are assigned to the CdSe core product by the selected methods paragraph; the exact purification/measurement state is not explicitly specified.

provenance_review.sources_checked: Complete main paper (9 PDF pages) and complete Supporting Information (7 PDF pages), including main-paper first page and Experimental Section on PDF page 2.
provenance_review.supplier_purity_finding: The main paper first page contains abstract/introduction, not a Materials/purchasing section. No supplier names or reagent purity/lot statements were found in the main paper or SI. Missingness label is justified within these inspected sources.
provenance_review.prior_method_reference: The selected protocol cites Flamee et al. as an earlier method (reference 21); inherited supplier/grade/lot details are not established by that citation and were not imported.
provenance_review.remaining_scope: This is a faithful literature extraction with explicitly missing fields, not a fully specified executable protocol.

scientific_review_notes: Zinc blende and wurtzite are different polymorphs; only zinc blende is supported for this selected recipe.
260 degrees C is stated for complete CdO dissolution. Do not plot a measured isothermal growth trace or numerical cooling ramp from this source.
The 5 min duration is time between Se addition and water-bath quenching.
3000 g denotes relative centrifugal force, not 3000 rpm.
Se is a powder dispersion in ODE, not dissolved TOP-Se stock. Its carrier volume remains unknown.
Oleic acid is introduced during post-synthesis ligand replacement, not as the initial growth ligand; myristic acid is the initial ligand source.
The 3 nm diameter is approximate and inferred from absorption; neither quantitative core morphology nor core PLQY was reported in the selected paragraph.
The 1:1 precipitation ratio is relative to the reaction mixture, whose total volume cannot be fixed because the Se dispersion volume is missing.
